finalText:
**Redis died and took the service with it.** One cause, 18 minutes.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | Cache bypassed, reads hit the store direct |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive` service down |

Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 against a max of 500. All 13 reconnects failed, spaced 80s apart, never recovering.

Check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. Then cap the queue so the store cannot drown.
